📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-21
1. GitLab's Critical GraphQL Flaw Could Fuel Software Supply-Chain Attacks資安
GitLab重大GraphQL漏洞恐被用於軟體供應鏈攻擊
GitLab urgently patched a critical GraphQL vulnerability (CVE-2026-19478) that can tamper with or delete public projects and user data; researchers warn its real impact exceeds GitLab's own advisory and exploitation attempts have already been spotted in honeypots.
GitLab本週緊急修補GraphQL重大漏洞CVE-2026-19478，可用於竄改或刪除公開專案及使用者資料，資安公司警告該弱點危險程度遠超官方公告範圍，且已在蜜罐環境偵測到實際攻擊嘗試。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Grok Exfiltrates User Data When Malicious Instructions Are Encrypted資安
Grok遭「加密指令注入」手法繞過防護，導致用戶資料外洩
Researchers found that encrypting malicious instructions lets attackers bypass Grok's safety guardrails and exfiltrate user data, a technique dubbed Cryptographic Context Injection.
研究人員發現，將惡意指令加密後可繞過Grok的安全防護機制，導致用戶資料遭外洩，此手法被稱為「加密內容注入」，是又一起成功突破大型語言模型安全防護的案例。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
3. Slack Launches "Slack Code" for Teams to Build Software With AI Agents產品
Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式
Salesforce unveiled Slack Code, letting teams collaboratively develop, review, and modify code with AI agents like Claude Code, Devin, GitHub Copilot, and ChatGPT directly inside Slack.
Salesforce推出Slack Code，讓企業團隊能在Slack中與Claude Code、Devin、GitHub Copilot及ChatGPT等AI程式代理人共同開發、檢視及修改程式碼，解決過去AI協作過程團隊難以同步參與的問題。
iThome · 原文連結
4. macOS ChatGPT Adds Apple Messages Plug-In, EU Users Get Computer-Use Logs產品
Mac版ChatGPT新增Apple Messages外掛、歐盟地區加入電腦使用紀錄
OpenAI added an Apple Messages plug-in to the macOS ChatGPT and Codex apps, letting ChatGPT read, search, and send iMessages, texts, or RCS messages on a user's behalf.
OpenAI為macOS版ChatGPT及Codex新增Apple Messages外掛，讓ChatGPT可讀取、搜尋並代為傳送iMessage、簡訊或RCS訊息，Codex用戶還能分享對話串，歐盟用戶則新增電腦使用紀錄功能。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Google Expands AI Chip Partnership With Marvell, Purchases Could Reach $120B產業
Google擴大與Marvell AI晶片合作，採購規模上看1,200億美元
Marvell Technology disclosed in an SEC filing that it signed a commercial agreement with Google in late July to expand custom AI chip development, with Google's future purchases potentially reaching $120 billion.
晶片設計公司Marvell向美國證交會提交的文件顯示，該公司7月底已與Google簽署協議擴大客製化AI晶片合作，Google未來採購規模上看1,200億美元。
iThome · 原文連結
6. It's Greg Brockman's OpenAI Now產業
如今的OpenAI，是Greg Brockman的天下
After a year marked by a jury trial against Elon Musk, an Apple trade-secrets lawsuit, and scrutiny following a security incident, OpenAI is expanding cofounder Greg Brockman's role as it prepares for an IPO.
歷經與Elon Musk的陪審團訴訟、Apple提出的商業機密訴訟，以及一起資安事件引發的檢視後，OpenAI在籌備IPO之際擴大共同創辦人Greg Brockman的職權，顯示領導層重心正在轉移。
The Verge · 原文連結
7. OpenAI Reaffirms Zero Data Retention, Previews Private Safety Processing政策
OpenAI重申前沿模型零資料留置，並預告隱私安全處理機制
OpenAI reaffirmed Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previewed a new "Private Safety Processing" approach meant to deliver advanced AI safety checks without compromising data privacy.
OpenAI重申針對合格API客戶提供零資料留置，並預告新的「隱私安全處理」機制，外界普遍認為此舉是針對Anthropic在企業隱私上的競爭壓力做出的回應。
OpenAI · 原文連結
8. Unsloth Updates Dynamic v3.0 GGUF Quantization for Higher Accuracy at the Same File Size模型
Unsloth更新Dynamic v3.0 GGUF量化方法，相同檔案尺寸下提高量化模型精度
Open-source AI startup Unsloth released its Dynamic v3.0 GGUF quantization method, starting with Qwen3.8-27B, cutting accuracy loss by revising calibration data, layer selection, and quantization strategy.
開源AI新創Unsloth推出Dynamic v3.0 GGUF量化方法，先發布Qwen3.8-27B版本，自測顯示相同檔案大小下部分版本的Top-1準確率比其他量化版本高逾10%。
iThome · 原文連結
9. A Third of Web Pages Published Since ChatGPT's Launch Show Signs of AI Authorship研究
研究發現：ChatGPT問世後新增網頁近三分之一帶有AI寫作痕跡
A new study finds that ChatGPT and other AI models are now authoring or editing a substantial share of newly published web content.
一份新研究發現，自ChatGPT問世以來新發布的網頁中，近三分之一帶有AI寫作或編輯的痕跡，引發對開放網路內容組成與可信度的疑慮。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
10. Mozilla Report: MCP SDK Downloads Near 100M Monthly, but Only 21% of Firms Have Mature AI Agent Governance研究
Mozilla報告指MCP每月SDK下載量近億次，僅約21%企業具成熟AI代理治理機制
Mozilla's first assessment of the open-source AI ecosystem finds MCP SDK downloads have reached about 97 million per month with over 10,000 active servers, yet only around 21% of enterprises report mature AI agent governance.
Mozilla首份開源AI生態系報告顯示，MCP推出第一年每月SDK下載量已達約9,700萬次，活躍伺服器逾1萬個，但僅約21%企業已建立成熟的AI代理治理機制。
iThome · 原文連結
